description: Entering into Memoranda of Understanding between Sri Lankan Universities and Foreign Universities aimed at Educational Collaboration
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to enter into the following Memoranda of Understanding with a view to enhancing the positions of Sri Lankan universities in global ranking indices and establishing higher educational collaborations with foreign universities for the internationalization, was approved by the Cabinet:

*	Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Peradeniya and the Institute of Geology and Geophysics, Chinese Academy of Sciences, People's Republic of China, valid for a period of 05 years.

*	Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Kelaniya and Bharathidasan University of India, valid for a period of 05 years.

*	Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Moratuwa and the Institute of Multidisciplinary Sciences, Yokohama National University of Japan, valid for a period of 05 years.

*	Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Moratuwa and the National Institute of Technology, Tokuyama College of Japan, valid for a period of 05 years.
